purpose: Teach: 子連れ/いかんせん/寒気/絶句/思いこん/ほど遠い/年老い/顔立ち

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、子連れのご家族のお手伝いをしてあげましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we help that family with their kids?
lines.style: Warm and gentle, like she's inviting him in. Light, encouraging tone. A soft opening—not commanding, offering. The natural cadence of someone who trusts he'll want to help.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、いかんせん疲れちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I'm kind of tired right now.
lines.style: Small, honest admission. Hesitant—worried he might disappoint her. Quiet voice. The rhythm of a six-year-old being truthful even when he doesn't want to be.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、寒気がしたらすぐに教えてね
lines.en: Sho, if you start to feel cold or funny, you tell me right away, okay?
lines.style: Attentive and careful. Slight lean-in. Not alarmed, but genuinely checking. The tone of someone noticing something small and making space for it to matter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが帰宅されて絶句しちゃったよ、ご褒美が嬉しくて
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad came home and I got so happy I couldn't even speak. It was the best.
lines.style: Sudden brightness breaks through the tiredness. Words tumble out faster. Eyes lighting up. The unguarded joy of a child who still thinks his dad is a little bit like a superhero.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが厳しいと思いこんでらっしゃるみたいだけど、優しい方よ
lines.en: Sho, I know you think your dad is strict, but he's actually really kind.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not defensive. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Warm, steady—she's seen something he hasn't yet. Like she's giving him permission to see it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんみたいになるにはほど遠いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't know if I'll ever be as good as Dad.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Caught between admiration and doubt. Small voice. The worry of a young child measuring himself against someone bigger and finding himself short.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんも年老いてこられたわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's gotten older now, hasn't he?
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking out loud. Gentle acceptance. A pause before speaking—noticing time the way adults do. Soft, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに似た顔立ちって嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really glad I look like him.
lines.style: Simple and sincere. The pride is uncomplicated—no irony, no self-consciousness. Warm and direct, like he's just realised something true about himself.
